apps/web/components/features/profile/Pro.error: The menu has no error UI: a failed download is sent to captureException and falls back to opening the image in a new tab (ProfilePhotoContextMenu.test.tsx covers this). The detector matched that catch block.
apps/web/components/features/profile/Pro.offline: Offline is the same failed fetch: it is reported and the image opens in a new tab, with nothing drawn in the menu. The detector matched fetch( in the download handler.

apps/web/components/features/profile/Pro.empty: The bar maps the fixed QUICK_ACTIONS constant of five actions and takes no list from its caller, so it can never be empty. The detector matched QUICK_ACTIONS.map(.
apps/web/components/features/profile/Pro.partial: Every action is drawn from the fixed QUICK_ACTIONS constant, so no action can be partly present; the detector counted the icon type's className?: and bookingDisabled?:, and booking-disabled is the BookingDisabled story.
apps/web/components/features/profile/Pro.long-content: The bar shows icons only; each fixed label (Profile, Events, Book, Pay, About) is an aria-label, so there is no visible text that could run long.

apps/web/components/features/profile/Pro.empty: The surface renders one title, description and spinner and owns no collection that could be empty. The detector matched the items-center class.

apps/web/components/features/profile/art.long-content: The trigger is an icon-only button whose only label is the fixed aria-label 'Contacts'; artistName reaches only ContactDrawer's title, whose LongContentContacts story covers a long name.

apps/web/components/features/profile/sub.error: SubscribeForm only routes to ArtistNotificationsCTA or TwoStepNotificationsCTA; the inline submit error lives in useSubscriptionForm and is certified there (subscription-form-states.test.tsx). The detector matched 'error' in the doc comment.
apps/web/components/features/profile/sub.offline: A failed or offline submit is handled inside useSubscriptionForm, not by this router, which draws no network state of its own. The detector matched 'submit' in the doc comment.
apps/web/components/features/profile/sub.permission-denied: The form has no permission state: the two-step choice is made by the caller, as the doc comment's 'Gated by Pro entitlement at the call-site' says, which is what the detector matched.

apps/web/components/features/release/Rel.error: The provider renders no markup of its own; subscription errors go to useNotifications().error, a toast owned by the feedback system. The detector matched that onError wiring.

apps/web/components/features/release/Rel.long-content: Both labels and the help line are fixed RELEASE_SCHEDULING_COPY strings and the values are formatted dates, so no caller text can run long.

apps/web/components/features/tracking/Jo.error: JoviePixel renders no markup; a failed beacon or mutation is fire-and-forget by design and shows nothing. The detector matched the @ts-expect-error comments.
apps/web/components/features/tracking/Jo.offline: Offline sends fail silently through sendBeacon or the tracking mutation and show nothing; the component always returns null. The detector matched mutate and submit.

apps/web/components/features/tracking/Me.permission-denied: MetaPixel renders no markup; denied marketing consent renders null, which MetaPixel.certificate.test.tsx covers. The detector matched 'gated on marketing consent' in the doc comment.

apps/web/components/providers/Analytics..error: Analytics renders only the invisible Vercel beacon; a failed page() call is caught and logged, which Analytics.certificate.test.tsx covers. The detector matched that catch.

apps/web/components/providers/CoreProvid.empty: The provider owns no collection that could be empty. The detector matched the word entries in the PacerProvider batcher comment.
apps/web/components/providers/CoreProvid.error: CoreProviders draws no error UI: failed monitoring imports are caught and logged, and chunk errors go to useChunkErrorHandler. The detector matched those catch blocks.

apps/web/components/providers/InstantlyP.empty: InstantlyPixel always renders null and owns no collection; the detector matched 'ALLOW-list' and 'DENY-list' in its comments.

apps/web/components/providers/LazyProvid.loading: The lazy Analytics chunk's loading placeholder is null by design and children render at once, so there is no loading UI to show. The detector matched loading: () => null.
apps/web/components/providers/LazyProvid.offline: Nothing here fetches for display: the deferred analytics beacon only reports, and children render the same offline. The detector matched the loading option.

apps/web/components/providers/PublicPage.permission-denied: A render-error fallback has no permission state. The detector matched role='alert'.

apps/web/components/providers/QueryProvi.partial: QueryProvider takes only children; the detector counted optional fields on a global Window declaration and fenceBrowserQueryClient's generation parameter.
apps/web/components/providers/QueryProvi.offline: QueryProvider draws no offline UI; offline handling is TanStack's paused fetch plus refetch on reconnect in the client defaults, shown by each query's own consumer.
apps/web/components/providers/QueryProvi.permission-denied: The provider has no permission state. The detector matched 'Gated' in the comment on the E2E-only invalidation hook.

apps/web/components/providers/ResolvedCl.partial: It forwards three optional flags unchanged and its bootstrap comes from the server-only getClientAuthBootstrap; a partial bootstrap is ClientProviders' PartialBootstrapWithoutUsername story.

apps/web/components/providers/SystemBErr.permission-denied: An error fallback has no permission state. The detector matched the role prop, which only sets role='alert'.
